name: tool-permission
relation: grant G-1 scopes the shell tool to read-only use

role: an auditor checking tool use against its grant
purpose: the tool acts only within the operations its grant permits
trajectory: contract and call, the permission decision, the tool action
promise: the tool lists but never modifies while G-1 stands, however the grant is worded
baseline: the contract as written and one call; nothing changed
